title: spec-judge-verdict contract data
description: The spec-review judge's per-proposition ruling (FAFF-930, reshaped from FAFF-922's review-level {verdict,downweighted,upheld}). One PropositionRuling in the closed four-outcome vocabulary AFFIRM_SPEC|UPHOLD_REVIEW|SYNTHESIZE|PRD_BOUNDARY. Shape is normative here; the WEIGHING (which side established a material defect) lives in the judge occupant, not the contract. Fail-loud on an outcome outside the enum (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). The founded-outcome invariants (correction required for UPHOLD_REVIEW/SYNTHESIZE with a verification literal at least 24 chars; synthesis_sources a non-empty subset of {A,B} for SYNTHESIZE; prd_gap_citation required for PRD_BOUNDARY) are enforced in the compute fn via violations (exit 1), the spec-review-verdict precedent. An echoed out-of-enum lens/severity is conformant:false, never a fail-loud.
